description: cranker-llm's hooks. The read guard: in the folders listed under read_guard.roots in the worker's config, a whole-file Read of a big text file is sent to the local worker first (does nothing until folders are listed). The scale (scale.ratio local tokens for each token of Claude, 5 by default; 0 turns it off): a session that uses the worker, or works under scale.roots, is told the rule when it starts and after a compaction, is reminded at every prompt while Claude does more than the worker's effective work (scale.least, 1 to 1), and below the scale gets a note with its numbers at most every 15 minutes. Effective is work that was right by the first or second try. Neither blocks anything else.

hooks.command: PY=$(command -v py || command -v python3 || command -v python); "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/local_share.py" --hook
